author: wilson-seok
title: Build (C++20) job fails - sccache cannot start because Azure Blob connection string URI is malformed
signature: sccache server startup failed cache storage failed to read unexpected permanent at read azbloberror code invaliduri message the requested uri does not represent any resource on the server|Configuration

failed_jobs.name: Build (C++20, non-blocking) / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: CMake configure step fails: C compiler ABI/test-compile check fails because sccache cannot start due to Azure Blob cache storage InvalidUri error

key_errors: CMake Error at /usr/local/share/cmake-4.1/Modules/CMakeTestCCompiler.cmake:67 (message): The C compiler "/usr/bin/cc" is not able to compile a simple test program.

sccache: error: Server startup failed: cache storage failed to read: Unexpected (permanent) at read => AzblobError { code: "InvalidUri", message: "The requested URI does not represent any resource on the server. RequestId:2150317a-701e-0026-27a7-72b828000000 Time:2026-11-12T13:09:19.7227680Z" }
root_cause: The sccache compiler cache backend is configured to use an Azure Blob Storage container (ghasccacheblobs.blob.core.windows.net) via an SCCACHE_* connection string/env var. The generated blob URI contains a double slash ("...blob.core.windows.net//sccache/..."), which Azure rejects with HTTP 400 InvalidUri. sccache treats this as a fatal server-startup error rather than falling back to no-cache, so every invocation of the compiler wrapper during CMake's initial C/CXX compiler ABI-detection try-compile fails, which CMake treats as 'C compiler is not able to compile a simple test program', aborting configure before any project source (including this PR's GPU changes) is touched. This is a shared CI infrastructure/configuration problem unrelated to the PR's diff (ocl_memory.cpp / remote_output_lifecycle.cpp), which never reaches the compiler.
reproduction_steps: Not reproducible by a contributor locally (depends on the CI runner's SCCACHE_* environment configuration and the ghasccacheblobs Azure storage account). To reproduce in CI: run the 'Build (C++20, non-blocking) / Build' job on any PR/merge-queue run while the SCCACHE_* Azure Blob connection string env var/secret still has the malformed (double-slash) container path.
recommended_actions: Fix the SCCACHE_* Azure Blob connection configuration (secret/env var, likely SCCACHE_BUCKET or SCCACHE_ENDPOINT, set at the organization/workflow level) to remove the duplicated path separator producing '.../blob.core.windows.net//sccache/...'
Alternatively, set SCCACHE_IGNORE_SERVER_IO_ERROR or allow sccache to degrade gracefully to no-cache on backend misconfiguration instead of failing the build outright

Re-run the failed jobs (or re-add the PR to the merge queue) once the sccache configuration is corrected or as a stopgap, since the failure is purely infrastructure-side and unrelated to this PR's code
Add a CI health-check step that validates the sccache backend connectivity/URI before the main build fans out across many jobs, to fail fast with a clearer message
prevention_strategies: Validate the SCCACHE_* Azure Blob connection string/URI construction logic (e.g., in reusable actions/workflows that set it) with a unit test or a lint step that rejects duplicated path separators. Monitor sccache server-startup failures as a dedicated CI health metric so a misconfigured secret is caught before it blocks many merge-queue runs.
historical_context: This exact signature has recurred 6 times since 2026-11-06 (pattern 08b993dbdc18ccac), most recently just hours before this run (2026-11-12T09:01:19Z), affecting PRs #38204, #39578, #39262, #39034, #39101. A related but distinct sccache failure (pattern e78859139d383270, 'Timed out waiting for server startup' on ARM64, External Service) occurred twice on 2026-11-05 and has not recurred since. The recurring nature strongly suggests the underlying Azure Blob connection string misconfiguration has not yet been fixed upstream.
